mainEntity.name: 会怎么推进，费用怎么定？

acceptedAnswer.text: 先梳理流程，再选一个小场景。 初次沟通免费，实施服务低至500元起。范围和费用确认后再开始。工具订阅、开发、培训与维护的范围和费用另行确认。

mainEntity.name: 一定要开发一套系统吗？

acceptedAnswer.text: 用好一个工具，改善一个步骤，也可以开始。 可以先一起看看 WorkBuddy 等现成工具是否适合你的日常工作，梳理用法；需要定制时，再讨论答疑、库存核对或内容整理。先试一个场景，再判断是否值得扩展。

mainEntity.name: 一定要训练自己的模型吗？

acceptedAnswer.text: 不一定。先评估现有模型、资料检索和工具配置能否满足任务，避免在问题尚未明确时投入模型训练。

mainEntity.name: 可以直接让 Agent 全自动处理客户业务吗？

acceptedAnswer.text: 先验证具体任务。涉及订单、付款、对外承诺或数据修改时，需要明确权限、确认和异常处理，再决定自动化程度。

mainEntity.name: Want AI, but unsure where to start?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start with a free conversation about one time-consuming task. What do staff repeat every day, where is the information, and where do mistakes occur? You do not need to know AI tools or have a complete plan.

mainEntity.name: How do we proceed and estimate cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Review the workflow, then choose one small use case. The initial conversation is free. Implementation starts at CNY 500, with scope and fees agreed before work begins. We'll agree separately on the scope and fees for tool subscriptions, development, training and maintenance.

mainEntity.name: Do we need to build a whole system?

acceptedAnswer.text: One useful tool or one better step can be a starting point. We can review whether existing tools such as WorkBuddy fit your daily work and how to use them. If custom work is needed, discuss support, inventory or content workflows. Try one use case before expanding.
